_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.zh: 中歐多國爆發疫情,其中奧地利、捷克、匈牙利、斯洛維亞今年截至10月累計報告逾6,000例病例,其中41-80%住院,病患多為街友或毒品使用者等脆弱族群,病毒型別涵蓋兩組相近的IB型,此波疫情遠高於去年,並已擴及9個歐洲國家,另迄未發現食源性傳播跡象。
_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.en: Several Central European countries have experienced outbreaks. Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovenia reported more than 6,000 cases cumulatively as of October this year, of which 41–80% were hospitalised. Most patients belong to vulnerable groups, such as homeless people or people who use drugs. The virus types include two closely related genotype IB clusters. This outbreak is far higher than last year's and has spread to 9 European countries. No evidence of foodborne transmission has been found so far.
